def solution():
    income = 75_000
    tax_brackets = [
        (10_000, 0.00),
        (30_000, 0.10),
        (60_000, 0.15),
        (float("inf"), 0.25),
    ]

    total_tax = 0
    previous_limit = 0

    for limit, rate in tax_brackets:
        taxable_in_bracket = max(0, min(income, limit) - previous_limit)
        total_tax += taxable_in_bracket * rate
        previous_limit = limit
        if income <= limit:
            break

    return round(total_tax)
